About local AI & the first download

Reading notes uses Qwen2.5 0.5B through WebLLM on your device. The first use downloads several hundred MB of model files and needs a WebGPU-compatible browser. Your notes are processed locally. Enable it once; on later visits, Read my notes loads the model when needed. Cached files may reduce downloads. Review the suggested tasks before adding them.

You can always add tasks using the form below.
